formalized as

  • CURIE: gmeow:formalizedAs
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/formalizedAs
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms

Attaches a machine formalization to a condition. NOT functional: one condition, several formalizations (one per engine), each a separate equivalence claim with its own confidence and vantage through the statement layer.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Condition -> gmeow:ConditionExpression

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:formalizedAs from gmeow:Condition to gmeow:ConditionExpression when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.
